fields.description: Raw import: bypass the target DocType's validate rules AND its controller lifecycle hooks (validate / before_save / on_update etc.) so app side-effects — e.g. hrms approver roles, GST address hooks, welcome emails, auto primary-contact — cannot fail the import. Use when the source data is trusted and destination business rules/automations block the import. May create records that skip those rules.
fields.label: Skip Validations (import raw data)

fields.description: Keep the source's original Created/Modified time and Owner/author on imported records, files and comments. Off (default) = use the current time and current user.
fields.label: Preserve original created/modified & owner

fields.description: Also migrate all Addresses & Contacts linked to each record (e.g. a Customer's or Supplier's addresses). These are kept out of the Link Resolution list.
fields.label: Include linked Addresses & Contacts

fields.description: Click 'Fetch Meta' to load the child tables of the selected DocType, then deselect any you don't want.
fields.label: Child Tables

fields.description: Click 'Analyze Links' to load every distinct Link value used in the source (parent + selected child tables). For each value choose Keep, Map (pick an existing record here), or Create New (pull it from the source).
fields.label: Link Resolution

fields.description: Transform field values during import. Remap Company 'Acme Pvt Ltd' to 'Acme Limited', or scope a rule to a child table (e.g. set Company / clear income_account inside item_defaults or accounts) so company-specific defaults resolve on this site. To skip company-specific defaults entirely, deselect that child table above.
fields.label: Value Mapping Rules
